brainlife.desc: Tractogram in the community TRX format: a directory of memory-mapped arrays with header, per-streamline and per-point data and groups.
brainlife.name: neuro/track/trx

original.desc: TRX: A community-oriented tractography file format

brainlife.readme:
https://github.com/frheault/tractography_file_format/blob/master/trx_file_memmap/specifications.md

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.track.trx.json

files.desc: trx is a directory containing various sub-directories such as dpg / dpv / dps / groups / header.json  / etc

identifying_risks: Individual white matter geometry can support re-linkage as a structural fingerprint
Headers and metadata may carry subject codes or acquisition dates
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers. Tier 4 conditions apply if used as a connectome fingerprint.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Strip free-text tags and dates from metadata before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only once aggregated across participants (e.g. a population atlas)
Tier 4 if used to build connectome fingerprints or predictive features

inputs_of.name: trak2zarr-vectors
inputs_of.purpose: convert a tractogram to Zarr Vectors

intended_use: Sharing tractograms with per-streamline/point data and bundle groups in one object.
Conversion to a Zarr Vectors store.
not_suitable_for: Apps that only read .tck or .trk; convert first.
